_note: Source-grounded entry for EQUIDERMA AI. Unsupported fields are intentionally null or empty.
description: Excessive sweating beyond what is needed for normal temperature regulation.
symptoms: Skin maceration or irritation may occur
causes: Primary focal hyperhidrosis or secondary causes such as medications or systemic disease
risk_factors: Certain medical conditions or medicines in secondary hyperhidrosis

appearance.general: Moist or macerated skin in areas affected by excessive sweating.

warning_signs: New generalized sweating, night sweats, weight loss, chest pain, or palpitations should be medically assessed.
doctor_discussion_points: Discuss age at onset, distribution, triggers, medications, and whether sweating occurs during sleep.
